subtasks.title: Implement semver compare() per semver 2.0.0 precedence
subtasks.aag_contract: compare(a: str, b: str) -> int returns -1/0/1 by semver 2.0.0 precedence: numeric major/minor/patch compared numerically (1.10.0 > 1.9.0); a pre-release version is lower than its release (1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0); pre-release identifiers compared field-by-field (numeric numerically, numeric < alphanumeric, alphanumeric by ASCII, more fields > fewer when prefix equal); build metadata (+...) ignored.
